title: OPERATOR.md frontmatter (AIP-9)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter portion of an AIP-9 OPERATOR.md manifest: an agent holding a role in an organization. Every field it shares with an AIP-42 AGENT.md is a $ref into AGENT.schema.json (never a copy, never allOf over two closed schemas), so a change to the AGENT field reaches the operator unchanged. The operator-owned fields are role, home, reports_to, participation, capabilities, runtime and profile. Fields marked deprecated are accepted for one minor version and read as their replacement.

id.description: The operator slug: machine identifier, dispatch slug and the body of its `operator:<slug>` compact ref. Lowercase, digits, dashes. The effective AGENT it resolves into takes this id.

persona_summary.description: One-sentence role description, written for a teammate to read at a glance.

entry.description: Relative path to the implementation file (e.g. operator.ts).

extends.description: The base AGENT this operator builds on (merge step 1). It resolves to an AGENT only, never to another operator.

tools.description: The AGENT `tools` items, plus the deprecated scoped form `{id, source?, scope?}`.

skills.description: The AGENT `skills` items, plus the deprecated pinned form `{id, source?, version?, allow?}`.

delegates_to.description: Agents or operators this operator may spawn or dispatch to. Never roles.

memory.description: The AGENT `memory` config. The items are owned by the operator, not by a session (AIP-72 `operator` anchor). The legacy `{kind, policy, share_with, external}` form is deprecated.

governance.description: The AIP-7 governance binding of the AGENT. The legacy inline `{policies, audit_log, autonomy}` object is deprecated: policies go to `policy`, autonomy to `autonomy`.

policy.description: The AIP-38 policy bound on THIS operator. A role never changes it (AIP-47); a node chain composes with it.

autonomy.description: 0 (always asks) to 10. 0 is the former `gated`, 5 `supervised`, 10 `autonomous`. At 0 the operator is not proactive.

role.description: The AIP-47 role this operator holds. A bare string is `{ref}`. Optional for one minor version: a reader without `role` falls back to `metadata.roleSlug`, then to `profile.role` when that value is a role slug that resolves, and emits a warning (`role_fallback`). Required after the alias period.

ref.description: AIP-54 ref to the ROLE: a slug, `ws://roles/<slug>` or a path to a ROLE.md.

bind.description: Slot name -> value. A key MUST name a slot the role declares, and the value MUST match the slot's declared type (checked against the role, not by this schema).

with.description: Rare scalar parameters the role declares. Never refs, never prose.

home.description: AIP-54 ref to the AIP-34 workspace node that is the operator's home: the root of its memory and of its default policy. A company node, a guild node, a user root. Not the node of a session: that is the session's `ground`.

reports_to.description: Slug of the operator this one reports to. Used only when no AIP-22 office seat gives the reporting line; a seat wins.

company.description: Deprecated: `home`. A ref to an AIP-6 COMPANY.md is read as the company node it sits in.

participation.description: Conversation participation. Optional: an operator that never joins a shared thread omits it.

pass_when.description: Host-evaluated predicate; when true the operator emits a 'pass' instead of a full turn.

capabilities.description: Capability surface the operator declares. Negotiated against runtime offer at registration.

runtime.description: Portable runtime binding only: kind, harness ref and AIP-45-validated config. The session preset, the posture and the auth profile are host configuration (AIP-46) and are never written here. When kind=in-process (default), the operator runs as a per-request persona in the host's shared in-process shell. When kind=agent-cli, turns go to a spawned AIP-45 harness session.

ref.description: AIP-45 HARNESS reference. Required when kind=agent-cli. Conventional shape: '<package>#<export>' (e.g. '@agentproto/adapter-hermes#hermes') or a workspace-relative path to a HARNESS.md.

session.description: Deprecated: session lifetime and idle policy are owned by AIP-46 and the host. A host MAY read this as a hint during the alias period.

config.description: Per-runtime configuration that the host applies when spawning / dispatching to the bound AIP-45 manifest (layer 3 of the AIP-46 session config). The host MUST validate every entry against the manifest's declared `modes` / `options` / `continuation.supported`; unknown ids are a hard load-time error.

mode.description: Id of the manifest-declared mode to activate for this operator. At most one per operator (modes are mutually exclusive). Omitted = manifest's default behaviour (no mode patch applied).

options.description: Map of manifest-declared option id -> value. Each value MUST satisfy the option's declared type / enum / min / max. Unknown ids are rejected at load time.

continuation.description: Continuation strategy id. MUST be a member of the manifest's `continuation.supported`. Omitted = manifest's `continuation.default`.

profile.description: Position prose. `role` is the job title and responsibility as a person would write it on a door plate; it is not a role ref (that is the top-level `role`).

voice.description: Deprecated: tone and register belong to the AIP-25 persona (`persona`). A reader folds it into an inline persona and warns.

boundaries.description: Deprecated: dropped from the shape; use the top-level `boundaries`. A reader folds the entries into `boundaries` (union, dedupe) and warns.

allOf.description: A gated operator (autonomy 0, or the deprecated governance.autonomy: gated) is never proactive.

slotValue.description: A value bound to a role slot: an AIP-54 ref, or a tool ref (the AIP-42 `tools` item form).

legacyScopedToolRef.description: Deprecated: an AIP-14 tool narrowed for this operator.

legacySkillRef.description: Deprecated: an AIP-3 skill pinned for this operator.

legacyMemory.description: Deprecated memory form. `kind` maps onto the AGENT memory config (AIP-9 section Memory); `share_with` becomes AIP-38 read grants on the memory store.

share_with.description: Operator ids granted READ access to this operator's memory. Deprecated toward AIP-38 read grants.
